summary: Suavecito says AI amplifies people but cannot replace human judgement, faults sensational AI rhetoric and wants AI companies held to ordinary ethics.

statements.quote: AI is not making you dumber or smarter. AI will amplify whatever is there in the first place.
AI cannot replace human judgement and it's not even close.
There are legitimate problems. But overhyping clearly incorrect assumptions and feeding it to the populace at large is obviously the worst of them.
AI is stealing human discovery. Why aren't AI companies held to the same standard of ethics as literally everyone else?
Anti AI people sound like Anti internet people from 30-40 years ago.
